Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Description: Unified storefront for official and community Dalamud plugins. Browse, compare sources, review findings, install, update, and manage your library.
Changelog: Add an opt-out integration that routes clicks on Dalamud's own plugin-updates-available notification into Omega > Updates while leaving Dalamud's Update/Open installer action buttons intact. Detect only Dalamud-origin AutoUpdateManager availability notifications; the bridge fails closed if Dalamud's internal notification layout changes. Render recognized/reference endpoint findings (including GitHub/source/documentation/registered-platform endpoints) with a green check treatment while explicitly avoiding any implication that the whole plugin is safe. Keep threat-intelligence, insecure HTTP, unknown host, public/special/private IP, collection-service, and webhook endpoint findings in their normal review colors. Advance configuration schema to 24 for the notification-routing preference.
